metadata.name: league
metadata.description: Weekly stock-basket league on Solana: beat MEDIAN

instructions.name: boost_round
docs: Add a sponsor boost to a round's pot (anyone, before settlement starts).

instructions.name: claim
docs: Pay out an entry (its payout, or the stake of a void round) to its
owner. Anyone can call it (the keeper does, so winnings arrive on
their own); the money only ever goes to the owner. Closes the entry
once any basket has gone back too.

instructions.name: enter_backer
docs: Back a creator's team with one ticket.

instructions.name: enter_creator
docs: Enter as a creator: lock a basket plus one ticket. Remaining accounts,
per leg in `weights` order: [mint, user token account, vault].
The first creator with `team_key` becomes its captain (and names the
ETF); a later creator with the same key joins that team as a clone.

accounts.name: token_program
docs: The stake mint's token program (classic Token for USDC).

accounts.name: basket_token_program
docs: The basket tokens' program (Token-2022 for xStocks; may equal token_program).

instructions.name: fund_season
docs: Seed the season pot (used for thin-pot top-ups). Anyone can.

instructions.name: return_basket
docs: Send locked basket tokens back to their owner once the round is over.
Anyone can call it (the tokens only ever go to the owner). Remaining
accounts, per leg to return: [mint, vault, owner's token account].
Legs can be returned in several calls (e.g. if one token is paused).

instructions.name: set_asset
docs: Allow (or disable) a token in baskets, creating its vault if needed.

instructions.name: settle_begin
docs: Commit the settlement totals. Conservation is checked here; the
per-entry payouts that follow must add up to `total_payout`.

instructions.name: settle_finish
docs: Finish once every entry has its payout and they add up.

instructions.name: settle_write
docs: Write payouts for a batch of entries (remaining accounts, writable),
in any order. Rewriting an entry in the same epoch replaces its payout.

instructions.name: void_round
docs: Void a round: everyone gets their stake and basket back. Keeper/admin
any time before it is settled (bad prices, outage); anyone once
VOID_GRACE has passed after the end.

errors.name: NotAdmin
errors.msg: Only the admin can do this

errors.name: NotKeeper
errors.msg: Only the keeper or admin can do this

errors.name: BadRound
errors.msg: Round is not in the right state

errors.name: BadBasket
errors.msg: Basket must hold 3-10 distinct allowed tokens with weights summing to 10000

errors.name: BadName
errors.msg: Name must be 1-32 bytes and the buy fee at most 2%

errors.name: TokenNotAllowed
errors.msg: Token is not allowed in baskets

errors.name: NoSuchTeam
errors.msg: No such team in this round

errors.name: NotConserved
errors.msg: Settlement does not conserve the round's money

errors.name: SettlementIncomplete
errors.msg: Not every entry has a payout yet

fields.name: is_crypto
docs: Crypto (wrapped BTC, ETH, SOL…): capped as a slice of the basket.

types.name: Config
docs: Program-wide settings. Its PDA also owns every vault: the ticket vault
(stake mint) and one basket vault per allowed stock token.

fields.name: season_pot
docs: Season pot: half the take, used to top up thin pots.

fields.name: platform_balance
docs: Platform's half of the take, withdrawable by the admin.

types.name: Entry
docs: A wallet's place in a round. Closed (rent back to the wallet) once the
payout is claimed and any basket has gone back.

fields.name: index
docs: Order of entry: settlement payouts are written in this order.

fields.name: payout_epoch
docs: settle_epoch under which `payout` was written (0 = never).

fields.name: amount
docs: Base units actually received by the vault.

types.name: Registry
docs: The tokens a basket may hold.

fields.name: entry_close
docs: Entries rejected at/after this time (unix seconds).

fields.name: end
docs: Settlement allowed at/after this time.

fields.name: stake
docs: Fixed ticket, stake-mint base units.

fields.name: cap_multiple
docs: Max team gain = cap_multiple × team stake.

fields.name: max_backers
docs: Per team, captain excluded.

fields.name: bonus
docs: Sponsor boosts (and later ticket yield) added to the winners' pot.

fields.name: inputs_hash
docs: Hash of the published settlement inputs: anyone can recompute payouts.

fields.name: settle_epoch
docs: Bumped by every settle_begin: payouts written under an older epoch
don't count, so the keeper can restart a settlement cleanly.

types.name: Team
docs: One ETF. The first creator with a team key is the captain; a later creator
with the same key (a clone: same stocks, same weights to 1%) joins the team.

fields.name: members
docs: Non-captain members: clones and backers.

fields.name: buy_fee_bps
docs: Fee (bps) the creator earns when someone buys the ETF through the app.
